title: Spades
tagline: Four seats. Two partnerships. One deck.
taglineZh: 四个座位，两对搭档，一副牌。

lines.en: Four seats. Two partnerships. One deck.
lines.zh: 四个座位，两对搭档，一副牌。

lines.en: Bid your tricks. Spades are always trump.
lines.zh: 先叫墩数。黑桃永远是王牌。

lines.en: Follow suit, break spades, and cover your partner.
lines.zh: 跟花色、破黑桃，替搭档兜底。

lines.en: Go nil for a hundred, or blind nil for two.
lines.zh: 零墩奖一百，盲零墩奖两百。

lines.en: Four AI levels, hot-seat, or four phones on one network.
lines.zh: 四档电脑、四人同屏，或同一网络的四部手机。

lines.en: Bags, bag penalties, and a race to five hundred.
lines.zh: 袋分、罚分，一路打到五百分。
